name: Customer support operations manager
summary: Sets up how a support team works: quality reviews, escalation rules and reports on what customers keep asking. Turns ticket data into fixes for the rest of the business.

changelog.note: First release: 30 checked sources (Zendesk, Freshdesk and Intercom docs on routing, SLAs, automations, staffing, QA and help centres; AI disclosure under EU AI Act Article 50 and CMA guidance; complaint deadlines; data deletion), four skills, six prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs, with access levels 1 to 3.
